name: Stroke of Luck
entries: You have a marvelous knack for succeeding when you need to. If you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can turn the roll into a 20.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
